# Farm hen source
Source: https://grab3d.com/models/animals/chicken/
License: CC0-1.0, retained in LICENSE.txt.
Publisher origin disclosure: AI-assisted model/textures.
The original downloaded model is static. A project-derived vertex-clustered mesh reduces the light source from about 400k triangles to about 35k triangles, preserving UVs and feather colors. Two generated bones blend a subtle neck/head peck; locomotion is not supplied by the source. Originals are kept in Source.
